provenance.paper_title: ReWind: Understanding Long Videos with Instructed Learnable Memory

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Learnable read queries attend to stored history; write queries distill instruction-conditioned frame representations into compact tokens appended in temporal order.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Per-frame encoder features are preserved in a separate buffer, and Dynamic Frame Selection retrieves instruction-relevant high-resolution features for the second stage.

A trained cross-attention write interface uses learned queries to compress each new frame representation and persist it in the memory bank. For ReWind, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of long-term memory bank.

derived.hybrid_relation: Learned memory states and selected modality-native frame features are combined as LLM input.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (long-term memory bank) changes through a trained but frozen update module; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
